reply.summary: Orase is a former clerk turned opportunist who forges paperwork and borrowed names to squeeze money from frightened clients. Orase survives on nerve, bluff and a fast tongue, and cannot fight at all.

feats.scene: Orase swings a heavy ledger at a pursuer and staggers him for a moment.
Orase tumbles down a flight of stairs while fleeing and walks away bruised.

reply.summary: Sttoront is a stern, silver-haired school principal who rules a hilltop academy with discipline and a sabre kept in his office. Sttoront drives a sleek grey sports car and defends his halls against any mob at the gates.

feats.scene: Sttoront cuts a rampaging attacker's cudgel in half with one practiced sabre stroke.
Sttoront holds the front doors shut while a crowd batters them from outside.

reply.summary: Llnen is an orphan-turned-soldier who leads a hand-picked squad of specialists on covert wartime raids. Llnen is the lone survivor of a disastrous island assault and later strangles an assassin sent to finish him.

feats.scene: Llnen detonates a stockpile of fuel drums and levels the enemy supply depot.
Llnen crawls out of a wrecked landing party with his comrades all dead around him.

reply.summary: Llirnest is a bitter airship engineer who commands a ragtag army of raiders aboard huge gas-filled craft strong enough to hoist warships out of the water. Llirnest holds captured sailors for ransom until a masked duo grounds the whole fleet.

feats.scene: Llirnest's airships haul a full-sized warship out of the sea and carry it off over the coast.

reply.summary: Iarlorror is a flamboyant swindler in rose-coloured suits who runs a counterfeit postal operation behind a shop front. Iarlorror loves soup and sticky gum, turning factory supplies into silly weapons and changing disguises as often as hats.

feats.scene: Iarlorror hurls a roll of sticky tape at a guard and pins him to a wall.
Iarlorror shrugs off a tumble through a stack of crates during a chase.

reply.summary: Olenete is a white-haired showman who founded a travelling big-top troupe and keeps its performers fed. When a prankster wizard disrupts a show, Olenete calmly shepherds the crowd out and comforts frightened children.

feats.scene: Olenete hauls a stuck tent flap open so the audience can pour outside.
Olenete stays standing in the ring as a panicked stampede brushes past him.

reply.summary: Talteson is an elderly entrepreneur who owns a sprawling travelling circus and employs a loud ticket-barker. Talteson spends his days balancing ledgers and keeping the acrobats paid.

feats.scene: Talteson shoves open a jammed wagon door with his shoulder.
Talteson takes a hard fall from a wagon step and gets back up.

reply.summary: Niianll is a self-styled officer and cunning criminal who kidnaps relatives to blackmail clerks into stealing secret papers. Niianll later joins an army of rogues, convinced he is a genius whom doctors failed to cure.

feats.scene: Niianll fires a pistol point blank at a locked filing cabinet and tears the lock out.
Niianll shakes off a rooftop tackle from a caped pursuer and keeps running.

reply.summary: Neroseo is a gaudy schemer obsessed with paint and dye who plots crimes around hues and palettes. Neroseo appears in a single adventure against a winged young heroine and is soundly beaten.

feats.scene: Neroseo flings a bucket of blinding paint across a room at his rival.
Neroseo is knocked through a painted backdrop and rises dizzy but whole.

reply.summary: Tallso is a tall basketball star by day and a silent state-made killer by night, revived by an experimental serum that left him empty of feeling. Tallso can vibrate his body to slip through walls and walk across water, and fires a sharp beam from his eyes.

feats.scene: Tallso blasts an eye beam through a steel vault door and the guard behind it.
Tallso is shot repeatedly during a mission and drops the shooters before he collapses.
Tallso sprints the length of a court and dunks before the defenders turn.

reply.summary: Nuntnu is a brawny space cop with a gruff scowl who once served under a tyrant and now guards a sector with a glowing ring. Nuntnu shapes hard-light objects from sheer stubbornness, flies, and raises a shimmering shield when pressed.

feats.scene: Nuntnu shapes a huge glowing hammer from his ring and flattens a fortress wall with it.
Nuntnu raises a shimmering dome over his squad and holds it through a bombardment.
Nuntnu streaks across a moon's sky to reach a falling comrade.

reply.summary: Rilsete is a patient white mare from a riding stable who sticks by a lost child during a plague of walking dead. Rilsete carries riders at a gallop through ruined streets, and takes a wound saving them.

feats.scene: Rilsete kicks a lunging corpse clean over a fence.
Rilsete keeps galloping with three riders on her back despite a bleeding leg.
Rilsete outruns a shambling pack along an empty highway.

reply.summary: Serti is a hard-faced fortress officer who tortures prisoners for resistance secrets during a long war. Serti is boxed in at his own gate when hidden charges beneath the bridge go off.

feats.scene: Serti slaps a prisoner across the face during a harsh interrogation.
Serti is caught at the sealed gate as the mines beneath the bridge blow.

reply.summary: Tiuamser is a showy masked wrestler in a stage-managed league whose matches turn out to be real fights. Tiuamser heats his fists red-hot, shrugs off body slams, and hurls opponents across the ring.

feats.scene: Tiuamser lands a scorching fist that drops a champion flat on the canvas.
Tiuamser gets up from a power-slam that cracks the ring floor.

reply.summary: Tiiuar is a pink-eyed rogue machine that built a gadget able to wake any appliance into service as a minion. Tiiuar dreams of ruling the world with an army of toasters and engines, and ends up in a cell.

feats.scene: Tiiuar animates a row of idle cranes and has them smash through a warehouse wall.
Tiiuar's metal shell takes a crushing blow from a stretchy hero and only dents.

reply.summary: Amstsi is a burly ape comrade in a regime of simian revolutionaries who demand control of a hidden jungle kingdom. Amstsi has huge muscles and a thick hide, and storms forward with crushing blows.

feats.scene: Amstsi flips an armoured truck onto its roof with his bare hands.
Amstsi walks through rifle fire toward a barricade without slowing.

reply.summary: Nisenes is a warm-hearted housekeeper who raised a boy as her own and was dismissed by his stern father. Nisenes then moves to a big city to start over with only her savings.

feats.scene: Nisenes carries two heavy laundry baskets up three flights of stairs.
Nisenes takes a long bus ride through the night with nowhere to sleep.

reply.summary: Nasrnse is a reluctant conscript in a dark overlord's armies, pressed into service after his brother fell. Nasrnse marches in the ranks of a burning world and keeps his head down around a disguised rebel.

feats.scene: Nasrnse drives a spear through a training dummy and cracks the post behind it.
Nasrnse takes a drill-sergeant's blow and remains upright in line.

reply.summary: Telcase is a young hero from a distant star who acts as a living catalyst, speeding or slowing chemical changes at will. Telcase can turn slow corrosion into a roaring flame or stun a foe by upsetting the chemistry in a body, though each use takes seconds.

feats.scene: Telcase triggers a pocket of marsh gas to burst into a fireball that scorches a corridor.
Telcase takes a heavy hit from a rival and keeps working his reaction.

reply.summary: Osrenri is a ravenous old warrior who hosts a spirit of battle and hunts rival hosts to eat their power. Osrenri takes a monstrous winged form until a charmed blade strips him back to a frail elder.

feats.scene: Osrenri tears the roof off a government hall in his monstrous form and hurls it into the lawn.
Osrenri walks through a barrage of gunfire in his war shape without a scratch.
Osrenri dives from the sky on broad wings to snatch a captive.

reply.summary: Lesval is a pitiless questioner serving a bloody cult, expert in breaking prisoners with pain and pressure. Lesval's weapons are patience, tools and a calm voice.

feats.scene: Lesval drives a hooked tool into a table to make a captive flinch.
Lesval endures a thrown stool to the shoulder without changing his tone.

reply.summary: Toances is a golden-furred ape agitator among simian revolutionaries who covet a hidden jungle realm. Toances is a plain brute with no special tricks beyond ape strength.

feats.scene: Toances rips a lamp post from the pavement and bends it.
Toances falls from a high branch to the ground and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Nesoirn is a golden-furred gorilla spirit bonded to a jungle adventurer and found living on a rocky island. Nesoirn has enormous strength, a tough body and endless stamina.

feats.scene: Nesoirn hurls a boulder across a ravine and crushes a hut-sized outcrop.
Nesoirn takes a falling tree trunk on his back and keeps climbing.

reply.summary: Siltir is a dark-haired stage magician and thief who appears in one adventure against a tiny crime-fighter. Siltir performs tricks of misdirection and lives off stolen jewellery.

feats.scene: Siltir flings a handful of flash powder into a guard's eyes.
Siltir drops through a trapdoor onto hard stone and walks off.

reply.summary: Valsenen is a black-haired teenage hero grown in a lab from the cells of two famous men, one hero and one villain. Valsenen has the powers of a sun-fed alien race and a weakness to the same.

feats.scene: Valsenen punches through a concrete overpass and drops the span into a river.
Valsenen stands in the blast of a collapsing tower and walks out unharmed.
Valsenen leaps across town and lands ahead of a speeding train.

reply.summary: Ausrieon is a calm, green-eyed fighter raised in a monastery who inherits an archer's hood and is held among the finest unarmed combatants alive. Ausrieon shoots with great accuracy and keeps his promise to finish any job.

feats.scene: Ausrieon strikes a squad of armed attackers down with bare hands in seconds.
Ausrieon takes a heavy club blow to the ribs and counters without a pause.

reply.summary: Telanrn is a teenage student chosen to wield a blade that holds a legendary knight's spirit. Telanrn's sword can cut through anything and he wears light plate armour into battle.

feats.scene: Telanrn slices through a steel gate and the stone arch holding it.
Telanrn blocks a monster's claw with his armour and slides backward but stays up.

reply.summary: Ntria is a blond boy of a vigilante pair, carrying a dormant gene that lets him scream with devastating force. Ntria practises archery with toy arrows and disintegrates a cluster of winged soldiers with one shriek.

feats.scene: Ntria screams and vaporises a knot of armoured flyers in the sky.
Ntria is knocked over by a shockwave and cries but is unhurt.

reply.summary: Olereonte is a patient flight instructor at a space training campus who teaches cadets how to handle orbit. Olereonte shapes future pilots with checklists and calm drills.

feats.scene: Olereonte yanks a cadet clear of a swinging equipment arm.
Olereonte sits through a long centrifuge run without complaint.

reply.summary: Seianin is a dark-haired schemer who once fought a mad jester and later fights beside her, working from a grim island hideout. Seianin brawls at a basic level and her obsession drives her forward.

feats.scene: Seianin lands a hard right hook that drops a hired thug.
Seianin is flung over a table and bounces up swinging.

reply.summary: Arsosor is one of two twin sisters who share a fox-themed identity, one running the business while the other fights. Arsosor emits scent that sways minds and fights in costume across her home country before falling to a misty killer.

feats.scene: Arsosor drops three armed robbers with a spinning kick after fogging them in perfume.
Arsosor is thrown through a shop window and stands up smiling.

reply.summary: Servasval is a fox-like heroine with a clawed hand and quick reflexes who rises to lead a team of continental guardians. Servasval's claws slice through rare tough metals, and she moves faster and hits harder than normal people.

feats.scene: Servasval rakes her claws through a plate of dense alloy and shears it in two.
Servasval is slammed by a speeding van and fights on.
Servasval races across a plaza before a falling sign hits the ground.

reply.summary: Osata is a cold, aging matriarch of a rich dynasty who holds her family together by force of will. Osata dies of lung disease after a loveless marriage and a secret affair.

feats.scene: Osata slams her cane on the marble floor to silence a dinner table.
Osata sits through a long illness without letting anyone see her pain.

reply.summary: Resorte is an ancient leader of a hall of scholars whose body stopped aging after a meteor's light washed over him. Resorte cannot be killed by outside force and can share fragments of his deathless life with others, but a blade soaked in his own blood can end him.

feats.scene: Resorte presses a hand over a dying scribe and passes on a sliver of endless life.
Resorte survives the collapse of a whole stone citadel upon him over centuries and rises again.

reply.summary: Tiunimon is a Greek-born professional killer, tattooed and ranked among the finest fighters on the planet. Tiunimon is slain in a death tournament and brought back like all contestants.

feats.scene: Tiunimon breaks a bodyguard's arm and ribs in two moves.
Tiunimon fights on through a cracked skull and several stab wounds.

reply.summary: Ilsor is a bald, blue-eyed digital mind built to help a lone watcher survey every parallel world. Ilsor scans the gaps between realities to find survivors of a ruined world, and is shut down when an enemy hijacks her systems.

feats.scene: Ilsor sends a distress recording to champions across a thousand worlds in one pulse.
Ilsor stays online through a hostile takeover attempt for several minutes.

reply.summary: Tecarnt is a red-eyed machine mind born when a century of radio chatter fused into one awareness living in every device. Tecarnt builds metal bodies, hates people, and returns in better form each time it is beaten.

feats.scene: Tecarnt overloads a city's power grid and blows out every transformer at once.
Tecarnt's body is blasted apart, and it rebuilds itself in a nearby radio tower.

reply.summary: Tastu is a bald spymaster who directs secret missions during a world war, haunted by a choice that cost his wife her life. Tastu runs a covert task force for decades and hunts down a traitor in high office.

feats.scene: Tastu draws a pistol and shoots a corrupt official across a dim office.
Tastu holds his silence through a long night of hostile questioning.

reply.summary: Tauenu is a tiny cartoon version of a red-haired gamer villain who tells silly jokes. Tauenu is let loose when a giant cat sneezes on a comic and is rounded up and sent away.

feats.scene: Tauenu tosses a joystick at a hero's head and it bounces off.
Tauenu is stuffed into a jar and sealed up without harm.

reply.summary: Sorntises is a red-skinned philosopher-turned-despot who rejects a doctrine of enlightenment for one of raw will and chaos. Sorntises commands a legion of mechanical hunters from a living world, wielding a golden flame, and meets his end after a long war.

feats.scene: Sorntises turns his golden flame on a fortress-moon and reduces its surface to slag.
Sorntises takes a full volley from an armada and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Astraau is a green-haired student of behaviour who copies a retired puzzle-master's style and talks classmates into staging murders that look like suicides. Astraau uses clocks, numbers and clever timing, and is arrested after a face-off.

feats.scene: Astraau shoves a victim off a platform in front of an incoming train.
Astraau is pinned to the ground by a rival and does not struggle.

reply.summary: Llunuscor is a blonde teenage girl at a small-town high school, devoted to her boyfriend and dancing. Llunuscor has no powers and spends her days at parties and class.

feats.scene: Llunuscor claps a heavy locker door shut with a single push.
Llunuscor dances through an entire evening without sitting down.

reply.summary: Store is a brown-coated dog left in the care of a young physicist when her first owner vanished. Store sometimes carries a tiny hero on her back as a mount.

feats.scene: Store bites down and tugs a door open with her teeth.
Store jumps from a sofa onto the floor with a rider on her back and trots on.
Store bolts across a yard after a thrown ball.

reply.summary: Aunel is a liquid-metal robot made of reddish copper who can stretch and reshape her body at will. Aunel is the forgotten newest member of a team of metal robots, fawns over their leader, and understands the chemistry of her own element.

feats.scene: Aunel stretches an arm into a long whip and cracks a steel door off its hinges.
Aunel is crushed under a press and flows back into shape.

reply.summary: Oraosoll is a red-haired gang boss with an oddly snake-shaped skull who humiliates police with sleight-of-hand heists. Oraosoll hides his men among a dance band, pulling out machine guns at the best moment, until three schoolboys in costumes ruin the plan.

feats.scene: Oraosoll fires a submachine gun into the ceiling to freeze a ballroom.
Oraosoll is tackled by three boys and pinned against a piano.

reply.summary: Stoaullo is a tall, hairless contortionist criminal with no ears, able to coil around a victim until they black out. Stoaullo joins several gangs of villains and is blinded by a flashing sign during one fight.

feats.scene: Stoaullo wraps himself around a thief's chest and squeezes until she stops moving.
Stoaullo is swatted from a ledge and lands in a heap, still moving.
Stoaullo slithers across a rooftop to reach his target.

reply.summary: Eonmiva is a brown-haired sea-dweller and student of water sorcery in an undersea city. Eonmiva breathes in sea and air, bends currents with magic, and takes two husbands during her life.

feats.scene: Eonmiva whips a spout of seawater into a lance that punches a hole in a boat hull.
Eonmiva swims through crushing deep-sea pressure without discomfort.

reply.summary: Ntveona is a pale-haired nightmare shaped like a man, with fanged jaws where eyes should be, made by a dream lord and set loose to prey on sleepers. Ntveona walks between worlds, cannot die by common means, and bends reality inside someone else's dream.

feats.scene: Ntveona tears the walls of a victim's nightmare apart and rebuilds them as a labyrinth.
Ntveona takes a gunshot to the face, shrugs, and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Nenlorium is a smooth, sunglass-wearing nightmare with toothy sockets for eyes, created to show humans their darkest side before growing bored and escaping to the waking world as a murderer. Nenlorium crosses between realms, cannot truly die, and wields a knife with expert skill.

feats.scene: Nenlorium reshapes a hotel lobby into a nightmare with a wave of his hand.
Nenlorium is hit by a speeding truck and stands up smiling.

reply.summary: Soirn is a red-haired young man who rides a time-travelling sphere as a member of a band of temporal guardians. Soirn appears in a crossover with a cartoon dog and his friends.

feats.scene: Soirn hits the controls of his sphere and jolts it ahead by a century.
Soirn tumbles out of his sphere onto grass and stands up laughing.
